name: Lusaka
subtitle: Lusaka, capital of Zambia: its numbers, a short history and places to see beyond the World Heritage list.

keyPoints.text: About 2,212,301 people live in Lusaka District (counted 2022).
Lusaka began as a small village named after a local clan chief.
A railway built through Lusaka in 1905 made the settlement a significant thoroughfare.

parts.text: Lusaka began as a small village named after a local clan chief.
A railway built through Lusaka in 1905 made the settlement a significant thoroughfare.
Lusaka replaced Livingstone as the capital of Northern Rhodesia in 1935.
Northern Rhodesia was granted independence on 24 October 1964 and became Zambia.
The Lusaka district population grew from 1,084,703 (2000) to 2,212,301 (2022), roughly doubling in 22 years.
